Messages.Author: Daniel H
Messages.Body:
Is a vampire allowed to take multiple reqruit or employ
actions per turn?

I suppose yes.

Can a vampire employ the same type of retainers more then once
each turn? (or reqruit the same type of ally)

I suppose not but this came up last night, and in the rulebook
there seems to be a distinction between using action cards (6.1.6)
and taking an inheirit employ actions using the same card from the
hand. There is also special notes that bleeds, politics and actions
given by the cards sorted under 6.1.6 cannot be repeated, but no such
note under employ,reqruit or equip.

Refs:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec6_1_5

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec6_1_6

//Daniel

the action symbol over the retainer/ally symbol.

Messages.Author: andrea....@infinito.it
Messages.Body:
you can employ two different retainers as they are different cards, you
cannot employ two raven spy as they are the same card.
NRA prohibits 2 bleeds, 2 political and twice the same card.
see the last paragraph of 6.1.6

you can also try a search on google with:
NRA employ author:LSJ

the second result could be a good reading...
Andrea

Messages.Author: Gregory Stuart Pettigrew
Messages.Body:
> you can employ two different retainers as they are different cards, you
> cannot employ two raven spy as they are the same card.

Additional note:

You cannot perform 2 Raven Spy actions, but you can perform a Raven Spy
action and then perform a Muricia's Call action and emply a Raven Spy.
